title: Deployed lean schema lacks SemanticNode ranking fields the Python client selects
description:
The lean deployed schema (amplify/data/schema.ts) omits SemanticNode authorityScore, authorityRank, acceptedReferenceMentionCount, distinctSourceKindCount and relationCount, which amplify/data/resource.ts and graphql_authoring.SEMANTIC_NODE_FIELDS use. Any getSemanticNode call from the Python client fails validation (seen in the relevance sweep --apply on sandbox ppy-6b4094). Per AGENTS.md, fix the deployment, not the client.

```gherkin
Feature: Deployed schema matches the typed schema
  Scenario: SemanticNode fields are deployed
    Given the typed schema in amplify/data/resource.ts
    When the schema parity check compares it with amplify/data/schema.ts
    Then every SemanticNode field in the typed schema is in the deployed schema
```
